environment.description: Quarkus native image deployed on Google Cloud Run (gen2) with custom container security profile. Container image built with distroless base using Jib. The Cloud Run service revision specifies `--execution-environment=gen2` with the container annotation `run.googleapis.com/sandbox: gvisor`. The Dockerfile applies `chmod 555 /` recursively at build time and the Cloud Run service YAML includes `spec.template.spec.containers[0].securityContext.readOnlyRootFilesystem: true`. Additionally, the Cloud Run service has no mounted volumes and no in-memory filesystem emulation — the /tmp directory exists in the container image but inherits the read-only root filesystem constraint. The gVisor seccomp-like syscall filtering further restricts write-family syscalls (pwrite64, writev to non-socket fds) against paths outside /dev/null. Note: the in-memory ConcurrentHashMap still functions but disk-backed cache writes will throw IOException on any path.

config.volumes: none (no tmpfs, no emptyDir, no persistent volume)
config.tmp_directory: exists as empty dir in image layer, read-only at runtime
config.network_policy: egress restricted to internal VPC connector only
